note: The dep subtree `spikes/harness` carries this row's own edit to `carries_repair.sh` plus co-lane work. If certify refuses on a dirty dep the refusal is CORRECT and stays recorded: this run is not the commit it names. Re-run after the commit lands for a clean record.

controls.name: C1_healthy_case_still_fires
controls.must_fire_because: the whole fix could be obtained by making the function do nothing at all, and every interleaved arm would then be green on a corpse
controls.can_fail_because: a refusal placed too early — before the trailer is computed — leaves an own-lane commit with no `Carries:` and C1 goes red
controls.null_must_contain: a healthy own-lane run producing no trailer

controls.name: C2_defect_reproduces_pre_fix
controls.must_fire_because: the fixture must actually stage the interleave. If the PRE-FIX function leaves lane B's commit alone here, the defect was never reproduced and the post-fix green measures nothing
controls.can_fail_because: a fixture whose second commit lands after the repair, or one whose foreign lines are absent so the trailer is empty and v1 returns early, would show `unchanged`
controls.null_must_contain: a pre-fix run leaving HEAD equal to lane B's sha

controls.name: C3_post_fix_leaves_colane_commit_alone
controls.must_fire_because: the claim of this row is exactly this and nothing wider
controls.can_fail_because: dropping the identity assertion — the first v2 draft did, and this arm came back `rewritten`, which is how that draft was refuted
controls.null_must_contain: a post-fix run whose HEAD differs from lane B's sha

controls.name: C7_compare_and_swap_primitive
controls.must_fire_because: `the function refused` can be true for the wrong reason. The swap rests on `git update-ref <ref> <new> <old>` rejecting a stale <old>, so that primitive is asserted directly, in BOTH directions
controls.can_fail_because: a git that ignored the expected-value argument would accept the stale one, and a broken invocation would refuse both — the second arm separates those
controls.null_must_contain: update-ref accepting a stale expected value
